title: Green Sand Near-Infrared Reference Library and Detection-Limit Benchmark
description:
Open near-infrared reference library and detection-limit benchmark for foundry green sand additive control: 4,410 dry and 6,930 moist computed spectra (1000-2350 nm), 12 benchmark sets with baseline results and a leaderboard, the greensand-nir Python package, documentation and the preprint source. Spectra are computed by Hapke single-scattering-albedo mixing of USGS Spectral Library Version 7 spectra, with seacoal and red iron oxide effective particle sizes calibrated to 24 measured dry mixtures (Kuubata 2025).
